title: Project-graph vertices never embed: no vector route serves them despite embeddings_enabled and embed:true annotations
wanted_capability: Graph vertices whose schema properties carry embed:true (in a consumer project's campaign graph, several claim-shaped vertex types) should gain vector embeddings so bbox_hybrid_search's vector lane can rank them against prose competition. Observed: embedded_vertex_count stayed 0 across multiple accepted generations with index_policy.embeddings_enabled true and the text index current; bbox_reembed exposed no project-graph route and an explicit backfill reembed changed nothing. Wanted: a project-graph embedding route wired into the publish/index cycle, or the graph vertices riding an existing route, plus bbox_reembed coverage.
fallback_used: Text/BM25 lane only for graph retrieval; findability calibration proceeded on the text lane.
evidence: bbox_project_graph_describe retrieval block on a consumer project's graph: embedded_vertex_count 0 at an accepted generation
a campaign thread in another registered project
notes: Follow-up: the consumer embed config routes graph vertices to the shared text partition; all graph vectors were re-embedded and verified with a paraphrase probe, and the orphaned legacy partition was pruned via bbox_embed_partitions. Nothing pending on this gap.
resolution_note: obsolete: graph embed route landed in 373ff9e9 (Bucket::Graph route "graph" in crates/bbox-embed/src/embed/mod.rs, install-time enqueue and bbox_reembed(route=graph) backfill in src/embed_runtime.rs, embedded_vertex_count on bbox_project_graph_describe); design/connectors/unified-retrieval.md 7.5 M9e marked landed
